editorial:
Ever wondered what happens when two guys who think they are great filmmakers get way too deep into a real crime? You get this wild ride where Adam and Stu decide to track down a suspected serial killer just to get a hit show. It starts off as a funny quest with two friends who are totally out of their league, but the vibe shifts quickly as they realize they might actually be dealing with a monster. It feels like a mix of a prank show and a nightmare, making you laugh one minute and feel nervous the next.

The acting is surprisingly natural, and the way the tension builds keeps you glued to your seat. While some of the plot points are a bit messy, the surprises at the end make up for it. If you love stories about people making terrible decisions for fame, you will love this.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the man they were hunting was not the only danger. As things wrap up, you find out that the people they trusted were playing them the whole time. The filmmakers realize they were just pawns in a much bigger, deadlier game. After a chaotic struggle, the truth comes out about who the real killer is, leaving the guys shaken and realizing that chasing fame can actually get you killed.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true crime parodies and dark comedies.
